about.name: Mohab Ismail
about.paragraphOne: I'm an architect and real estate consultant focused on helping clients find their next home, from my available units or through tailored property search, and delivering complete design and build solutions — from concept to handover.
about.paragraphTwo: My background as a site engineer and project coordinator at reputable firms in Egypt gives me the practical knowledge and industry connections to manage your project with precision, transparency, and care.
about.footerTagline: REAL HOMES / SMART INVESTMENTS / LASTING VALUE
about.bannerParagraphOne: I help you find your next home, whether through my available units or personalized property search, while bringing your vision to life through architecture, interior design, and execution.
about.bannerParagraphTwo: I offer integrated solutions, from selecting the right property to considered architectural design, quality interior finishing, and careful project coordination through handover.

items.question: What property services do you offer?
items.answer: We help clients explore property listings and find suitable units for buying or renting. Contact us to discuss your requirements and available options.

items.question: Do you provide architectural and interior design?
items.answer: Yes. Services include architectural drawings, 2D plans, 3D visualization, interior finishing support, and custom furniture drawings.

items.question: Can you help with property handover inspections?
items.answer: We offer project-based handover and snagging support, helping identify observations that may need attention before or during the handover process.

items.question: Do you manage architectural projects?
items.answer: Project management support can include progress follow-up, coordination, documentation, and reporting, depending on the project scope.

items.question: Do you offer services across Egypt?
items.answer: Services can be discussed for projects in different locations across Egypt. Availability and scope depend on the specific project.

items.question: How can I request a service or get more information?
items.answer: Use the contact details or WhatsApp link provided on the website to explain what you need and discuss the next steps.
